structural_change: S81-SAFE-FIX/SH 10-19 (SAFE-DESIGN items 4/1/7): ingest APIPE 8 -- the IKEY address stage B (ap1_gs -> a2_blk + offsets -> ap_kcode, 22 levels / 775-787 ps in the route lint of 65df312e3) split in two: B0 registers the block base rbase + sb * 2176 and the bit-disjoint IKEY offsets, B adds them (two-operand adds); one more row-start bubble edge, same values (host_native_pipe pos8 PASS, apbskip8 / apstale8 caught; seq_host bench unchanged edges). reset_landing 2 stages (rst_n release +2 edges, scheduled constant), io_hold_margin 0.03 (was 0.025). History: S81U-SEQ (S81-DV p4f..p4i, owner-approved DV plan): L0 link leaf of dsdv_seq_host: host lane port + host ingest (dsfd_host_native, unchanged) + host write decode (dsfd_host_sd STATIC) + svc / kit ports + regional status fold + one rung hop each way; flop-first / flop-last pins, die hold budget. S81U-SEQ3 (gate 8940e10e9 clock_rule FAIL: 24,085 sinks on one root, TT ins 306.7): the host ingest's own Gray-FIFO clock domains (dsfd_host_native clk_h / clk_i, ot_link_afifo crossings) get their own CTS roots ck_ih / ck_ic (same stream clock, related phase-0 roots, ordinary STA across them), as the S81 host tile dsfd_host_c DSFD_HOST_PQ_BOOT (ck_ingest roots); estimated roots ~8.8k / ~10.3k / ~5.5k sinks, each < 15k. A two-leaf split cannot reach < 15k: dsfd_host_native alone is ~19.2k flops (u_hx 16 x 514 + u_ox 16 x 289 + engine). Ingest engine APIPE 2 -> 4 (26-level ap1_local -> ap_raddr stage registered; ROWS / IKEY +1 bubble edge a row, RAW unchanged); pin-flop payloads off the reset net (891 loads). S81U-SEQ4 (gate4 df8031f2c WARN: 3 roots max 9,551 sinks, TT ins 239.9 / sp 33.2; reg->reg -69.7 ps at u_eng.ap1_rbase = base + stk * stride in one stage): ingest APIPE 5 (stack x stride partial products formed in stage A0, stage A1 a four-operand add; same values / bubble edges as APIPE 4). Reset WARNs u_hi.u_rsc / u_rsi reset_pipe 472 / 438 loads are inside the reused ot_rom_host_ingest (shared with closed dsfd_host views; not edited): below the 8,000 refuse bound, reset in->reg slack +409 ps. RTL-BUILD-S81 10-18 (bind5 residual (b)/(c)): two svc halves -- s_jd/s_hc/st_rg/s_hw become per-half s_jd_w/_e (merged in-leaf: done when both halves reported, same pin->jd_o edges), s_hw_w/_e + s_hc_w/_e (dsfd_host_sd NS 2 HALF 1: sector -> PC-owner half, markers to both), st_rg_w/_e (fault OR, live AND); _w set on the E face, _e set on the S face (E 449 -> 454 bits, S 552 -> 857 bits = 3.4/um). S81-SHLK 10-18 (route dsdv_sh_lk-ef442ffba NEEDS_RTL TT -36.2 / FF +8.14 / DRC 0, 173 endpoints: 86 u_hx.mem (ck_ih) -> head decode -> hx_pop -> rbin_c / ofree (ck_ic, 150-ps root-pair uncertainty), 73 u_hx.rbin_c -> 16:1 x 514-b read mux -> u_eng.dq, 11 u_eng.ra_rp[5] -> 512-b realigner select/shift -> ox_w_q / sc_acc): ingest APIPE 7 = registered FWFT host-FIFO head in clk_i (every head decode and the descriptor queue start at a ck_ic flop; host words +1 ck_ic edge, rate unchanged: host_native_pipe pos7 ck 1068/8473/532/633/1353 vs APIPE 6 1068/8472/532/630/1353) + 8 kept copies of the realigner pointer ra_rp (one per 32-b head slice; no cycle change). Host path f_host -> s_hw / t_host = golden + 2 edges (tb HSH 2); token path and every other port unchanged. S81-SHLK2 10-18 (APIPE-6 view 743e0021b native audit FAIL, receipt results/closure/shlk_pick_1018/native_audit.json: launch 254.9 > 220 vo_s[251], capture 201.0 > 190 st_rg_e[1], pin-flop spread TT 94.0 / FF 88.3 > 80): BOUNDARY STRUCTURE. (1) The single-flop rung hop (rn_o <= vi_s, vo_s <= rs_i) joined the S face to the N face 136 um apart with ONE flop: io_flop_at_pins anchored all 552 rung flops at N (y 131-134), so vo_s carried 136 um of output wire (S-face outputs x 75-175 launch 129-255) and vi_s 136 um of input wire (capture 87-188).  RL 1: the rung is LANDED at both faces, capture flop beside the input pin and launch flop beside the output pin (vi_s -> vi_q S -> rn_o N; rs_i -> rs_q N -> vo_s S), +1 edge each way (rung 6 -> 7 in dsdv_seq_host, V south command -> vo_s 7 -> 8; compiler dv_layer_compile SEQ vo_s_land 1).  (2) st_rg_w (NE corner) and st_rg_e (SE corner) folded into ONE flop between them (130 um from st_rg_e): each now lands in its own pin flop before the fold (+1 edge on the region status word). (3) Clock: ONE CTS root ck for the whole leaf (clock cts; ck_ih / ck_ic ports and pins removed, ingest clk_h = clk_i = ck as in dsdv_seq_host). The three related roots existed only for the retired 15k sinks-per-root cap (S81U-SEQ3) and cost the die-skew reserve (hold 100 / setup 150..210 ps) on every ck <-> ingest crossing: 20,461 FF hold endpoints and ~20k hold buffers at the APIPE-7 gate, and the post-repair boundary tail (APIPE-6 routed TT 230.3..321.6).  Re-CTS sweep on the APIPE-7 gate placement: one root, boundary spread TT 17.5 ps (route.cts_sink size 20 / dia 40 / levels 2 / dbb 60 / unbalance 0.5) vs 45.7 ps for the three-root ck tree; insertion 252 mean. Clock pin ck stays at E (254.88, 67.76), beside the tile centroid row (flop centroid 124, 66). Benches (ot-epyc5, Verilator 5.050): seeds 1-8 PASS, collide / stdrop fault, mutants 1-9 FAIL (9 = landing dropped), lint clean; witnesses results/rtl/s81_shlk_1018/rl1/.
